sloka: पौराणाम् अहिते युक्तः पित्रा निर्वासितः पुरात् ।तस्य पुत्रो अंशुमान् नाम असमंजस्य वीर्यवान् ॥१-३८-२२॥
transliteration: paurāṇām ahite yuktaḥ pitrā nirvāsitaḥ purāt ।tasya putro aṁśumān nāma asamaṁjasya vīryavān ॥1-38-22॥

translations.english: Asamanjasa's son was Anshuman. He was valiant, beloved and courteous to every one in the world.
